notes.title: Fatal Theory joins the Steam Halloween Sale!
notes.content:
What's better than smashing up some ~*SPOOOOKY*~ foes? Smashing up some ~*SPOOOOKY*~ foes at a discount!!!

Yep yep, from today until November 2nd you can enjoy this tale of ghosts, demons and woe for 20% off. Steal!

Here's a little sampling of the horrors you'll face within...

 Brain-hungry zombies
 Violent Demons
 A Malevolent Spirit Trapped Inside a Wine Bottle
 SKULL BATS
 Hounds of Hell
 Angry Wraiths
 An entire military force under SPOOKY DEMONIC POSSESSION
 Also you fight this one cool mech because we have diverse interests


And... you can even team up with One Sad Ghost! It cries all the time and isn't very useful. But you can do it! 

Wow. What a lot of Halloween for only $3.99 USD. Don't sleep on this one folks, or you're sure to have terrible dreams. Get it today!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26108550/a17fb2286fe6fb224b16a49917e5208dc3e008e2.jpg

notes.title: Patch 1 Live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
So Patch number 1 is live now and here is the list of changes we've introduced:

 999x combo achievement is now working
 You have a lot more control over the screen sizes. Besides the default size it will list all the screen sizes your monitor or screen would list in the screen resolution options
 The game screen now keeps aspect ratio (1x, 2x, 3x etc). If you pick a screen size in between aspect ratios it will use a black border to fill in the gaps around the biggest aspect ratio it can fit
 Fixed the level 7 crash, which was actually the ally Andy being broken. Not many people choose him to use, so that's why not many people reported the bug. Poor old Andy hahaha
 Tried to make the buttons less confusing. If in doubt, change the controls in the option screen


Also included are specific fixes for Linux and Mac:
Mac Patch
Somehow it looks like full screen is working now! Let me know if you run across issues.
Linux
I fixed the gamepad save files and players should be able to use Xbox controllers and change their buttons properly like everyone else. If you run into issues, let me know.

And that's it for now! Play safe this Halloween and have fun wrecking in the game :D

-Cheers,
Matt

notes.title: Updates for Bundle Purchasers
notes.content:
Hey wreckers,

I know a lot of you bought the game in bundles and are still waiting on your keys. So this thread is to keep everyone updated on the status of all of those, and also to let you know how to redeem your keys where manual collection is required.

So, going by bundle/promo:

 LazyGuys Bundle: I've received confirmation these have been emailed to players. If you're waiting on one, check your inbox.
 IndieGala Bundle: We've sent them the keys, now just waiting for them to send them out to players. I've heard they're notoriously slow at doing this, but they should hopefully be on their way.
 IndieGameStand PYWY: if you bought the game on IGS, you can redeem through the IGS backend. Just go to your game wallet and hit "Request Steam Key" on Fatal Theory.
 BundleBandits & IndieRoyale: These bundles were trickier, because the folks who ran them are no longer around. So what I've done is create a portal where you can request a Steam key by entering your Desura key from either of those two bundles (keys from other bundles won't work). You can find it here: http://www.2hitstudio.com/key-portal/ Please note, there is a turnover time of ~1 day on these requests.


And that should about cover it! Hit me up if you have any questions or comments, hopefully we can get the game in your hands ASAP.

Cheers,
2HitAdam
